claim_boundary: This tests online imitation on learner-influenced 5x5 Go states. Legality of played student moves is externally masked and is not evidence that the raw model learned Go rules.
causal_protocol: preview theta_t -> commit actual action -> obtain/withhold Sayuri feedback from the saved pre-action state -> update to theta_(t+1)
execution_mode: AWQ INT4 checkpoint dequantized once into a frozen FLOAT16 backbone; only FP32 LoRA and/or MQR sidecar parameters update by condition
